page.sessionDescription: Sign in again to access the employee directory.
page.title: Directory
page.description: Find employees in your authorized organization scope.
page.scopedAccessDescription: The backend controls which employees and contact details your role can view.

list.errorFallback: The employee directory could not be loaded.
list.defaultDescription: Search employees and review their current organization information.
list.archivedDescription: Review archived Nepal Telecom employees and their preserved lifecycle records.

search.label: Search directory
search.placeholder: Name, employee ID, designation or department

empty.currentDescription: Change the search or filters and try again.
empty.archivedDescription: Archived employee records will appear here.

detail.errorFallback: The employee details could not be loaded.
detail.title: Directory details

contact.title: Contact information
contact.limitedDescription: Contact information is hidden for your current role.

accountAccess.description: Suspend or reactivate temporary access without ending the employee's employment record.
accountAccess.suspendDescription: This will immediately block login and revoke every active session on all devices.
accountAccess.reactivateDescription: This will enable the account again. Previously revoked sessions will remain invalid, so the user must sign in again.
accountAccess.suspendedMessage: Account suspended. Login is blocked and all active sessions were revoked.
accountAccess.reactivatedMessage: Account reactivated. The user can sign in again with the existing password.

lifecycle.title: End employment
lifecycle.description: Use only when employment has ended. The account is disabled and active sessions are revoked.
lifecycle.reasonError: Enter a reason of at least 3 characters.
lifecycle.success: Employment updated to {{status}}. {{count}} active session(s) were revoked.
lifecycle.success_one: Employment updated to {{status}}. {{count}} active session was revoked.
lifecycle.success_other: Employment updated to {{status}}. {{count}} active sessions were revoked.

history.title: Lifecycle history
history.description: Administrative lifecycle actions are displayed newest first.
history.empty: No lifecycle actions have been recorded.

archive.title: Archive former employee
archive.description: Archiving preserves messages, audit records and employment history while marking the former employee as historical.
archive.reasonPlaceholder: Enter why this former employee record is being archived.
archive.reasonError: Enter an archive reason of at least 3 characters.
archive.success_one: Employee record archived. {{count}} active session was revoked.
archive.success_other: Employee record archived. {{count}} active sessions were revoked.

correction.title: Employee information
correction.description: Correct protected identity, contact or designation information with an audit reason.
correction.reasonError: Enter a reason of at least 3 characters.
correction.noChanges: Change at least one employee field before saving.

transfer.title: Transfer employee
transfer.description: Move this employee to another Office without replacing the employee identity, account or history. Current Office memberships and Office-scoped responsibilities are ended safely.
transfer.reasonError: Enter a transfer reason of at least 3 characters.
transfer.officeHeadDescription: This employee is the current permanent Office Head. Transfer the leadership and select the source-office replacement from Office Head Management.
